tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi lhan thabs dkyus su bcug pa nag 'gros bklag chog gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam zhes bya ba tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin la mchod phreng rgyas pa dang tshogs mchod sogs kha skong bsnan pa'i nag po 'gro shes bklag chog gsal ba'i me long 'god pa la/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'dod pas/ rang nyid kyi sgrub khang la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su chag chag dang byi dor la sogs pa legs par byas/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma'i bris sku dang*/ 'bur sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na tshul bzhin bshams pa'i drung du/ 'thas shing ngos snyoms pa'i sa gzhi'am/ stegs bu la sogs pa ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gi chus byugs/ khru gang la sogs pa'i tshad kyis zlum skor bya/ de'i phyi rol du sor phyed tsam bskyed pa'i zlum skor gnyis pa bya/ nang gi zlum skor dang mthun par chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab de la tshon dgye ba na/

chos 'byung gnyis dmar po thig gi gcod mtshams re khā dkar po/ nang gi zlum skor dang chos 'byung gi bar gyi khyams ljang gu/ mu khyud sngon po/ mu khyud kyi phyi nang gnyis ka'i re khā dkar po/ chos 'byung gnyis kyi dbus su zla gdan gyi steng du tshom bu dmar po bkod pa ni sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin la/ 'di nyid 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na/ ras sam dar dmar po la bris kyang rung zhes kyang gsungs/ de'i steng du mañji la sogs pa'i khar thod pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/ chang la sbrang ngam bu ram la sogs pa sbyar bdud rtsi ril bu'i phye ma btab pa dpral ba rang nyid la phyogs par bzhag de ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin/ de'i khar shing bu phra mos rgya gram byas la dar dmar gyis bkab/ de'i steng du me long ngam ma 'byor na shing leb la sogs pa'i khar sin+dhu ra tshag la btsags pa khod snyoms par bkram/ gser gyi thur ma'am/ med na rdo rje'i rtse mos chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su rgya yig gam bod yig gang yang rung ba'i bam̐ yig bris pa'i mthar mdun nas g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng mgo phyir bstan 'khor yug tu bris/ de yang oṃ gsum dang*/ de'i rjes su/ sarba dang*/ bud+dha dang*/ ḍā ki dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ war+ṇa dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ bai ro dang*/ tsa nī ye dang*/ hūm̐ gsum dang*/ phaṭa gsum dang*/ swā hā rnams rim bzhin bri ba ma gtogs 'bru re re nas bzlog pa ni mi mdzad/ 'di la'ang shar drang por oṃ dang*/ byang du ḍā dang*/ nub tu nī dang*/ lhor hūm̐ tha ma bris na cha snyoms par 'byung ngo*// mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re bri'o// de ni thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no// de rnams kyi steng du dar dmar ram/ la dmar ram/ ras dmar gang yang rung ba'i gur khang legs pa phub/

zan gtsang ma'i ril bu chung ngu la ras dkar gyi sdong bu btsugs pa 'bri mog gi mar khus kha dog bsgyur ba sin+dhū ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng ngam mdun phyogs gang rung du bzhag sgrub mchod rkyang pa'i dus ma bshams kyang rung*/ de'i mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga phyogs mtshams re rer bkod pa g.yon skor du bsham/ dku bag can gyi gtor ma lnga tshar ram/ bsdu na gsum du byas pa maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun nam/ rgyab phyogs gang bde bar bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa bcud dang ldan pa mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan dung chos rdor gzungs rnams tshang ba/ rdo rje dril bu nang mchod me tog dang bcas pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad rnams kyang ma tshang ba med pa bsham/ de dag ni cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba la thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgyal sras thu bo nā ro ta pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham thing pa// gsang mdzod kun gyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rdo rje 'chang dbang bla chen sa skya pa// rdo rje'i sras mchog rje btsun bsod nams rtse// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// sa skya paṇa chen gangs can mkhas pa'i rje// sa gsum skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa'i mchog /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin zhang ston chos rje'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// grub pa'i dbang po na bza' brag phug pa// grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje// grub rigs snyan brgyud mnga' bdag yar klung pa// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog

/bdag nyin chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo rings pa// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang*// bka' brgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// sku gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sku bzhi'i 'bras stsol gnyan ston sprul pa'i gar// sku drin mtshungs med gzhon nu blo gros zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rig sngags 'chang ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// rigs kyi gtso bo rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zhwa lu pa// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mkhyen rab rje// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rnam gnyis la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i ded dpon rdo rje 'dzin// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// snyan brgyud spel mkhas rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi// ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi// blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /bslu med skyabs gnas gtsug gi nor bu bsten// mar gyur 'gro ba'i don chen snying la zhugs// rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes pa'i dri ma 'khrud// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes skyong bar shog /yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol par shog

/snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang*// bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar shog /de ltar phyogs dang zla ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// nam zhig dus na dga' ma byu ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo mas// mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par shog /sin dhur laṅka li yi sdong bur bcas// ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu// nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can// 'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin khri shing bcom// mchog gi dhū tīr bzhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su 'thon// khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol par shog /lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lnga'i ti la ka /rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis// lus sems rtsa la dri bzhon zhugs pa yis// bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /tha mal 'od kyi gtum mo mdzes ldan ma// dhū tīr 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed kyis// haṃ yig gzhon nu yongs su mnyes byas nas// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sa thob shog /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor mar// rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar shog /rtsa rlung thig le e wam̐ dbyings su thim// sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas// bgrang yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag med kyis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro 'di skyong bar shog /sngon 'gro gtor ma chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥdang lag pa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum bstan pa dang bya khyung gi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ phaiṃ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes brjod de/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ de rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsams te/ thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/ un+mā da/ a sasmā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i mam ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhiṃ/ me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi ba tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kār+yaṃ/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gis mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes brjod/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgos su gsol// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi zad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas kyis// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbangaphyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srung*// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/

de nas kyang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs su gyur pa gsang spyod la lta bar mi dbang ba'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥn ya hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod cing rdo rje dril bu gsor dkrol drag tu bya/ gtor ma phyir sa gtsang sar dor ro// gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥn ya hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang shing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bla ma dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ga ṇa khaṃ zhes pas mang por spel/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha kā+e tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta na da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a kham̐ swā hā zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dang pos mchod yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gnyis pas de dag gis gnas khang byin gyis brlab/ gsum pas mchod pa byin gyis brlab par bsam la rol chen bya/ de nas maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad ma bde kye ltar byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed he ru ka'i bsgom bzlas bde mchog ltar byas pas rgyud sbyangs/ bdag bskyed rdzogs pa bzlas pa la thug gi bar du sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don ltar nyams su blangs/ zhes gsungs pas skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bdun sogs brjod/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes tshar gcig brjod/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya/

de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thamasaca da kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang*/ rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ yum gyi pad+mar babs/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka te no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba kar+m+mā su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/

nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrog pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

lus thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol pa/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la babs shing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rnam snang gi cod pan can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbus su g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu/

phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dang 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa dang*/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig la sngags phreng kha dog dmar po g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas/ bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa bskyed par 'dod na lte bar phabs te/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ sngags phreng lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa klog pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas/ rlung kha sbyor ci thub 'dzin/ rang gi smin mtshams dang*/ gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyar bzung*/ dga' 'khyil gnyis mthar snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam mo// de nas mdun gyi nang mchod dang mañji'i steng gi gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dha3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes phyag rgyar bcas pas lan gsum brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gsum char la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ sum̐ las ri rab kyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsis lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i rā ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad mda'i drwa ba dang ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la babs cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu/ phaiṃ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/

yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mchod pa'i yul du mdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas tshogs zhing khyad par ba spyan drangs mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni thal mo sbyar te/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rjas me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mar me ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas dri chab ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas rol mo ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sam pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta nā da sam bha we badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ sngags rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang rol mor bcas phul/ gos zung la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha'i gos srab la 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi// na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+ra ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes gos zung phul/ de nas snying ga nas rig ma bcu drug spros te dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma// ston ka'i mdog mtshungs pi waṃ lag

/pi waṃ sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkhar khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra wī ṇe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma// gser gyi mdog can gling bu'i lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra waṃ se hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum ma// bin dhu'i mdog can rnga zlum lag /rnga zlum sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga ma// margad mdog can rdza rnga'i lag /rdza rnga'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra mu rdzi hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo// keng shu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal// 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra hā se hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo// dbang sngon mdog mtshungs sgeg pa'i tshul// snyems pa'i lus dang glur ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma// 'char ka'i mdog mtshungs glu len ma// snyan pa'i glu dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra gi tī hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa// rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma// margad mdog mtshungs gar bsgyur zhing*// gar dang snyan pa'i dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

rdo rje lha mo me tog ma// gur gum mdog mtshungs me tog lag /me tog char dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa// rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma// du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag /bdug pa'i sprin dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lhag mo mar me ma// glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag /mar me'i 'od dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma// pri yang mdog mtshungs dung chos lag /dri yi char dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo me long ma// chu shel mdog mtshungs me long lag /sna tshogs gzugs kyis mnyes byed ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ru pa badz+re hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma// dza ba'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ra sa badz+ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma// margad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg dang 'khyud par ldan// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra spar+ṣe badz+ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma// kun+da'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag

/zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra d+dharma d+dhā tu badz+ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mchod/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bca' zhing*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ zhes brjod cing*/ thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ma ṇi rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra was sti rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sta rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan thams cad rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ha sti rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra tu raṅga a shwa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/

dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra khad+ga rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā shab+da kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+da sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra spar+she kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi āḥhūm̐ rnams phyi'i mchod pa ste/

so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas 'bul lo// nang mchod pani/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab pa dran par byas la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod kyi dbus nas blangs te thig pa 'thor zhing*/ oṃ mchod do// phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung ḍā+eṃ ki pa// don dam mchog brnyes grub chen an+tar pa// brtson pas grub pa brnyes pa'i tai lo pa// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa grub 'khor los sgyur ba nā ro pa// snyan brgyud slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham thing pa// zab lam mthar phyin klog skya shes rab brtsegs// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skad gnyis smra ba lo chen blo gros grags// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bla chen sa skya pa// de sras thu bo rje btsun sku mched gnyis// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa rin po che// chos brgyad 'ching ba kun spangs dkon mchog dpal// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar phyin brag phug pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// bshad sgrub chu bo kun 'dus dpal ldan par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

'di nas tshig gsum gsar bsgrigs/ mthu stobs dbang phyug seṅge rgyal mtshan zhabs// mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dpal// yab rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs// rgyal bas lung bstan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos kyi rgyal po blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// grub pa mchog gi ded dpon rdo rings pa// bstan pa'i srog shing tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nges par thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// thugs sras mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dpal/ tshig rkang gnyis po 'di gsar sgrig /mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// rigs kyi bdag po rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa dang*// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bud+dha rat+na'i zhabs// sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga'i mtshan// 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// rigs kun khyab bdag maṅga'i mtshan can la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang*// ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol thams cad mkhyen// mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

bla ma gsum gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang*// ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub rmor chen zhabs// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snyan brgyud gdams pa'i chu bo kun 'dus pa// gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje sems// drin chen bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang smin byed dbang dang grol byed lam// zab mo'i lam gyi man ngag ston mdzad pa// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mkha' khyab chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// bdag gi yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gsang sngags bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud/ 'di nas yid 'byung pa thug gi bar tshigs bcad gsar bsgrigs/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i// rjes 'brel yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod/ de nas mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug tu bdud rtsi'i thig le re byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bor gsal ba bde bas tshim par gyur par bsam zhing*/ bdud rtsi'i bar phud gtor mar phul la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ dpal mgon lha mchog rdo rje nag po che// gur gyi mgon po 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ shrī dharmā pā ya tsa turmu kha ya/ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa// yum chen rnam bzhi zhing skyong 'bum sde dang*// dregs byed sde brgyad bka' nyan 'khor tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ o rgyan yul gyi zhing skyong gsang chen gnyer// mthu stobs dbang phyug nor skyong dur khrod bdag /yab yum bka' nyan sha za 'bum sde la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos 'khor skyong zhing bstan pa srung ba dang*// sgrub po 'khor bcas skyong ba'i dam can mchog /bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma'i 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas mchog bzhi dang nye ba'i gnas mchog bzhi// mkha' spyod thugs kyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor tshogs ma lus par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing mchog gnyis dang nye ba'i zhing mchog gnyis// tshan+do ha zung nye ba'i tshan+do gnyis// sa spyod gsung gi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gyi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'du ba'i sa gnyis nye ba'i 'du ba gnyis// dur khrod zung dang nye ba'i dur khrod gnyis// sa 'og legs spyod sku 'khor ngo bo nyid// dpa' bo rnal 'byor sku sprul thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod zhes pa sogs// ngo mtshar mkha' 'gro'i gnas na bzhugs pa yi// 'gro ba sems can don mdzad ma tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ so gnyis yul dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas// dur khrod chen po brgyad na legs bzhugs pa'i// bsam gyis mi khyab dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pho nya'i tshogs// gnas rigs sngags dang las las skyes pa yi// gnas gsum rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po yi dwags sogs// sha za smyo byed rjed byed pho nya dang*// 'phrog ma grub pa'i rig 'dzin ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams nyer skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis po// bka' nyan bran g.yog gzhan yang gnas yul grong*// gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud rnam pa lnga// skye gnas bzhis bsdus khams gsum sems can rnams// tshim zhing zag med bde bas rgyud gang nas// myur du bla med byang chub thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ de nas rang gi lce rtser bdud rtsi myangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pas gsung rdo rje mnyes par bsam pa ni nang mchod do// yid 'byung gi mchod pa ni/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ

na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā naṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga khaṃ/ dharmā dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dha ye maṇ+ḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ba le na sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na dhe/ ban+dha swaḥs+tha na ba len+na tsā ye swā hā/ zhes pa phyag rgyar bcas pa bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rol chen bya zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rā hī bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bid+ye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhu ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yam ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ṇi shwa ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka ra li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥtra sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sh+lau ka gnyis dang*/ spros pa la dga' na/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa ni/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas tshigs bcad rnams la g.yas pas rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs kas snying gar bzung zhing*/ g.yon pas dril bu sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su gsil la/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dwangs pa'i sems kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags chen skyes bu gdul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde bas ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus par// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyi dbang bsgyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlabatu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen mo'i go 'phang 'thob par shog

/ces pas bstod la/ de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba mgrin pa phra ba kha g.yel ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang du/ e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs bzhin pa bsnams pa/

dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu do shal can gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu/ phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we badz+ra dharmā hri da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas gzungs thag bzung la/

rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste gzungs thag la 'khril nas song*/ rje btsun ma'i sku la phog pas ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ brgya rtsa dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe da ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sam pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/

pradz+nya pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we badz+ra dharmā hri da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// dung chos kyi mchod yon phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bum nang gi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes brjod/ de nas bdag 'jug la mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis su med pa la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum ltar dmigs la de thams cad dgongs pa rtse gcig pas bdag la dgongs par bsams te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes pas bum chu cung zad myang*/

rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa yon du phul bar bsam nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pas yon phul nas/ gsol ba btab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad par bsams la/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong bcings/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba blangs/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dpag tu med pa spros te/ byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur par bsams la/ ku shas bum chu rang la 'thor zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod lce la myangs pas lus sems bde bas gang*/ nang gi bar chad thams cad dag par mos/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// de yi bu la ci zhig bya/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes pas rigs dang 'dun pa ched du bya ba dris shing nges par byas/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ de nyid rje btsun mas rdo rje snying gar bzhag nas brtan par byin gyis brlab par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes dang*/ su ra ti sa ma ya staṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod rnal 'byor mas gsang bar gdams par bsams la rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes dang rnal 'byor ma'i phyag na gnas pa'i rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i drung du slebs par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pa ni phyi 'jug go /nang 'jug gi don du rnal 'byor ma'i drung du yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par mos nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces lan gsum brjod// rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig gong 'phel du bzung bar bsams la/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod/ khyad par du g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyi dam tshig spyir bud med la mi smod pa dang*/

khyad par shes rab ma la brten pa'i dam tshig brgyad po bzung snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bzung*// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang rnam smin sha rus kyi bar du sbyangs te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra waṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur de rnams 'od du zhu nas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim par yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/

phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon pa la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po/ mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re yod par gyur par bsam/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ slob dpon rin po ches bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa zhig dmar hril gyis byon nas rang gi khar thogs med du zhugs par gyur par bsam la/ ting lo'i mar me yod na de nyid/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rang gi khar bcug par bsams la/ rnal 'byor ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs mdzad cing yar 'khyug mar 'khyug mdzad pa'i mthar lte ba'i bam̐ yig la thim pas/

de nyid rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen la phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang nyid phyi'i rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar hām̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ lte ba'i bam̐ yig de nyid gdod ma nas nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa de thabs 'dis gsal btab pa yin no// de nas mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams kyis dges pa'i gar mdzad/ sngags kyi sgra chen po sgrog cing gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon te rang gi spyi bo nas thim par gyur par bsams la/

oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra waṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ drag tu brjod cing ḍā dril dkrol gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang rje btsun ma'i sku dpag tu med pa byung ste rang gi spyi bo nas thim par gyur par bsams la/ sngar bzhin sngags dang spos rol bya ba ni phyi'i rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs pa'i sgo nas dbab pa yin/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas gsang gnas kyi bar du/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbubs stong sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam pa'i mas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor bas/ dbu ma'i nang nas yar bya 'phur ba bzhin snying ga'i thad du song bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur/ dbu ma'i yas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dkar po g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar 'khor bzhin pas snying ga'i thad du byung bas snang ba thams cad stong nyid kyi ngang du thim zhing*/ dga' 'khyil de gnyis snying gar ro gcig tu 'dres pas bde stong gnyis med ye shes kyi ngo bo dga' 'khyil dmar skya shugs drag tu 'khor ba dang*/ mthar de nyid nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur par bsams/ brjod med kyi ngang la ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag cing spos rol bya ba ni gsang ba bde stong dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor ma ngo sprad pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ dhu dhu ra gu h+ya sa ma ya/ de ltar byin rlabs zhugs pa de rnams mi 'bral zhing brtan par bsams la/ lus kyi go cha'i lha rnams dran pas oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces tshar gcig brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod cing byin rlabs kyi myong ba la cung zad mnyam par bzhag

me tog gi phreng ba rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su phul ba'i stangs ka tsam byas/ me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rje btsun mas rang gi spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa staṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la/ zhes gsung bar bsams shing spyi bor bzhag de ltar sems dang bam̐ lhan cig skyes pa'i phag mor ye nas gnas pa cho ga de dag gis gsal bar byas pas/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sgrib byed bsal ba'i mtshon byed du/ rnal 'byor mas gdong g.yogs bkrol bar mos te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa hā ra pa ṭa laṃ pa hrīḥtraṃ/ zhes dang*/ khyed rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor la ltos zhes gsungs shing bltas pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur par mos/ de dag ni 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa'o// dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la/ maṇ+ḍal bshams la/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas yon 'bul/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /ces pa'am yang na/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

rang nyid sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ phai/ཾ zhes brjod pas/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar bkra lam gyis byon pa'i he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i klu len/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā lī la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod pa'i las brtsam/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur par bsams la/ me tog 'thor zhing dril bu gsil bas/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi klad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e wam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes brjod/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis zla ba ltar dkar ba'i bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba yal 'dab dang bcas pa cung zad yo bar 'dzin bzhin pas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur par bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

tsakra bī ra s+t+wāṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ kā kā s+ya/ u lū kā s+ye/ shwa nā s+ye/ sū ka ra s+ye/ ya ma dā dhī ye/ ya ma ru trī ye/ ya ma daṃ ṣi trā ṇi yo/ ya ma ma tha ni/ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag pa yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas/ rang nyid kyi spyi bo nas thim/ rang nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba la rje btsun ma 'khor bcas kyis rab tu gnas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor ba ni dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du thol thol byung rje btsun ma'i zhal nas 'thon rang gi khar zhugs snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi dam gyi lhar gzung snyam pas me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rje btsun mas me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhag cing gsung bar bsams la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra waṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

zhes lan gsum brjod/ sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i sku bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing rje btsun mas gsung bar bsam/ gsang dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di ltar byed de/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le thod pa'i nang du lhung ba/ rje btsun mas rang gi lce thog tu bzhag par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thod pa nas bdud rtsi blangs te lce thog tu bzhag mgrin pa'i lam nas myang pas/ lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems dam tshig pa'i tshul dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing*/ gsal stong bde ba brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par gyur par bsams la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod byed pa la dbang zhing*/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing rje btsun mas gsung bar bsam/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa dpal he ru kar gyur pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang du byin par bsam pa la/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtses blangs la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/
