hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ brjod cing lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ dpral ba rnams su mas nas yar thig le bya/ mkha' nang gi byang chub kyi sems de nyid lte bar drangs pas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ de bzhin du snying gar drangs pas snying ga'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ mgrin par drangs pas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' bral gyi ye shes nyams su myong*/ spyi bor drangs pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis khyab/ byang chub kyi sems la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab/ bde stong zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar gyur par bsams la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs gnyis med kyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing gsung bar bsam/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i zhal nas gsung bar bsams la/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes gsungs par bsam/ de'i don ni/ bden pa'i dngos po ye nas cung zad tsam yang yod ma myong ba chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ces bya ba yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ de'i ngo bo la gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa'i dri mas gdod ma nas gos ma myong bas dri ma med pa/ de lta bu'i yul stong pa nyid dang yul can gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i gnyis med ye shes kyi rdo rje yi stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom zhes pas zung 'jug bde ba chen po rgyud la skyes par gyur/

de'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mtha' dag bsgom pa la dbang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes gsung bar bsam zhing brjod/ de ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ byin rlabs thob pa'i bka' drin gyi yon du/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlabatu gsol/ lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul gyi/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum sogs brjod cing byin gyis rlabs la/ phaiṃ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul la/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod phul/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes nang mchod gtor/ bstod pa ni/ ḍā ma ru'i 'go 'dren gyis rol chen bya zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod la/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdug dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sgra snyan sogs mchod pas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog

/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dngos 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /de nas mgon po che chung gi gtor ma rgyas par spro na gtor chog phyag len ltar dang*/ mdor bsdus ni gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs byin gyis brlabs la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ 'og min bde chen dag pa'i pho brang nas// rnam snang thugs las sprul pa'i mthu bo che// bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rdo rje gur// dpal ldan mgon po 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// yongs 'du'i tshal dang gshin rje'i pho brang dang*// 'dzam gling de wi ko ṭa'i gnas mchog nas// 'dod khams gtso mo nam gru re ma tī// dpal ldan lha mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// snang srid bha ga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag mo dbyings phyug yum// sngags srung drag mo ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso// yum chen ral gcig 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// bsil ba'i tshal dang ha ha rgod pa dang*// siṅga gling dang ti se gangs ri dang*// dar lung gnas dang kha'u'i brang rdzong nas// zhing skyong dbang po 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// dur khrod brgyad dang lho phyogs ri sul dang*// rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi bsam yas dang*// na la rtse dang dpal ldan sa skya nas// las mgon pho mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// byang shar ma ru rtse yi dur khrod dang*// rgya gar bam so dmar po'i brag ri dang*// dar lung brag hram la sogs gnas mchog nas// gnod sbyin lcam dral 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// gsol lo mchod do rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshogs// sgrub bo bsten no bla ma'i bka' srung che// 'bod do bskul lo rnal 'byor dgra lha'i tshogs// rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor mas mchod// dza gad sman phud rak+ta'i btung bas mchod// rnga chen rkang gling rol mo'i sgra yis mchod// dar nag 'phan chen sprin ltar gtibs pas mchod// yid 'phrog spyan gzigs nam mkha' mnyam pas mchod// rab brjid snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ros mchod// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas rgya mtshos mchod// bde stong dbyer med ye shes rol pas mchod// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po khyed kyis srungs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyen po khyed kyis bstod// dpal ldan bla ma'i 'phrin las khyed kyis spel// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'dod don khyed kyis sgrubs// bstod bskul 'di'ang rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'o// dur khrod bdag po la gtor ma mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa ltar 'bul ba ni/

gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e chad pas nam mkhar rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ram̐ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ suṃ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po las grub pa'i gru bzhi pa mi rus kyi rkang dang*/ rtsib rus sna tshogs kyis steng thog phub pa/ thod skam gyi mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan cing*/ rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ 'og tu rus pa dang sha khrag sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa/ de'i nang du paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis pad+ma'i gdan/ ma sur+yā maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis zla ba'i gdan gnyis su gyur/ gdan gyi steng du sa bon hūm̐ dang am̐ las dung dang 'gron bu hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa las dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus shin tu brjid pa'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams shing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas g.yon pa'i brla la brten pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan chas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum la 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ de gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul nas dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/

hūm̐/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che// phrin las rnam bzhi'i don mdzad pa// dad ldan dam tshig chen po yis// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// shrī sh+ma sha na a dhi pa ta ye e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+wam̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// ces pas bstod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren rnams tshar bcad pa dang*/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing chom rkun thams cad bcing ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i phrin las bcol/ ljags rdo rje sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza/ ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ shrī sh+ma sha na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā tsi ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul bas gsol te dges par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pya d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ nang mchod gtor zhing*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren rnams tshar bcad pa dang*/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing chom rkun thams cad bcing ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol zhes phrin las bcol/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// rnam dkar keng rus dag pa'i gzugs// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par// gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun// nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod// yang dag lam la nyer gnas te// lus can bde la 'god mdzad pa'i// srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyob// phan bde kun stsol khyod la bstod// gang gis khyod bsgrub khyod mchod na// dam bcas bzhin du nyer dgongs nas// ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin// bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang*// dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis// dpal ldan bstan srung 'khor bcas mchod// phrin las gang bcol grub par mdzod// ces pas bstod/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ phaiṃ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+wam̐ dṛ sh+ya hoḥzhes gtor mgron spyan drangs la gtor ma phul bar bsams te/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs shing*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsi/ un+mā da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da yaḥ

i maṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan tu/ ya thai ba/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya/ sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung skyob sba ba'i phrin las stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas mgron dgug oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ad+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid sa'i lha mo brtan ma bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/

ma ltar byams shing sring ltar nye ba rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srungs/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bya ba dang spyod pa nyes pa la ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ na mo bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas tshogs mchod ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa dang khyad par du thod pa'i snod du ma dā na zhes chang dang*/ bā la zhes sha rnams bkod pa mdzes par bshams pa'i tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ tshogs pa mang po yod na las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad la byin rlabs gnang bar zhu zhes brjod slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan mang du brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur par bsam pa ni shin tu gal che bas dmigs pa ma yengs par bya/ de nas tshogs kyi phud snod gnyis su blugs pa dang*/

ma dā na snod gcig tu blugs pa dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul/ spro na gtor ma rnams la yang phud thams cad nas ma lus par phul/ slar yang thams cad la nang mchod chu chang gis bran/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du sman phud 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du tshogs phud 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /ces brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi drung du tshogs phud 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rje btsun ma la phul/ de nas gur mgon lcam bral sogs kyi gtor ma yod na yang so so'i gtor sngags kyis rgyas par 'bul ba'am mdor bsdu na/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes dang*/ oṃ shrī dharmā phā la tsa turmu khaṃ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ shrī sh+ma sha na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā tsi ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes dang mthar/

oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsi/ un+mā da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhiṃ/ me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭa bhū ñca tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kram tha/ ma ma sarba kar+yaṃ/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa rnams phyag rgyar bcas pas phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ rnams kyis phyi mchod phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes phud kyis dkon mchog mchod/ de nas dam tshig spel ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du ma dā na'i

chang snod pad+ma bha ñja thod pa dpral ba rang la bstan la bzhag de'i steng du bā la sha cung zhig bzhag la las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal/ pad skor byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// bdag gi tshogs kyi khyad par 'di// dad pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags kyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ e ma zhi ba chen po kye// tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs bsregs// 'di 'dra'i bde ba chen po ste// kun kyang a ho su kha che// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod/ yang phyag gsum dang pad skor byas la/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa la ni the tshom med// bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag /rang bzhin gcig tu rol tu gsol// zhes pa'i lan du/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya las srin lag g.yas kyi steng gis bā la 'dzin pas rdo rje slob dpon nas rim bzhin ma dā na 'grim tshar ba dang*/ tshogs kyi rdzas nas ma tshang ba med pa slob dpon la nyis 'gyur sogs dpon slob thams cad la lag pa gnyis kas dbul zhing*/ len pa pos kyang lag pa gnyis kas pad skor gyis blang bar bya/ a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod cing blang dgos te/ he badz+ra las/ pad+ma'i lag pas blang ba dang*// de nyid kyi ni lag pas dbul// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de nas thams cad la phul zin pa dang*/ sa rjen la mi 'jog cing*/ slob dpon gyis/ thams cad tshogs la rol par zhu/ zhes brjod/ 'di dag gi skabs su snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben par byas la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis gtsang sme'i rnam rtog mi bya bar snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod pa'i bsam pas rdzas thams cad tshim par longs spyad/

khyad par dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bus sdom pa 'og ma'i bcas pa bsrung ba'i bsam pas ma dā na dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs sems kyis tshogs rdzas khyad du bsad na rtsa ltung du 'gyur te/ dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin rnyed// mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// tshogs kyi dus thams cad du rtsod pa dang kha gshags 'gyed pa sogs mi bya bar chos kyi gleng dang*/ rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de yang tshogs kyi skabs su sha la bā la dang*/ chang la ma dā na la sogs pa'i brda skad bya dgos te/ he badz+ra'i rgyud las/ gal te sangs rgyas gsang ba'i skad// mi gsung na ni 'grong par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsang ba'i skad kyis mi smra ba// de yis dam tshig nyams par ni// 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de thams cad kyis tshim par longs spyad pa'i rjes su/ las kyi rdo rjes snod gcig tu mas rim gyis tshogs lhag bsdus pa mtshan mo yin na grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar dang bcas rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du bzhag chu gtsang dang*/ slob dpon gyis chang gis kha phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i bar nas gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces phyi rol du/ ḍā dril dang rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig

/sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pas bkra shis smon lam bya/ tshogs mchod 'di la phyag len rgyas bsdus sna tshogs yod kyang*/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa 'dis don tshang zhing 'jug bde bar yod/ gong gi zhu 'bul rnams ma byas kyang chad skyon med do// rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos shing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da swa bhā we/ badz+ra dharmā hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wā/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rat+ko me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān badz+re he ru ka mā me muñca/ badz+re he ru kā+o bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa thams cad dang*/

cho ga lhag pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang yin pa de thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag chad kha bskang*/ bris sku sogs rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rten la me tog gtor la brtan bzhugs bya/ maṇ+ḍal gyi ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag nyid la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum thams cad khyab/ gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas smad kyi cha la thim/ rang yang stod smad nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba la/

/bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs// au ḍi bi sha'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du// grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa// 'khyud dang tsum bha'i bde bas rjes bskyongs te// kha sbyor mchog gis rol zhing bdag kyang skyongs// gaṅgā'i gling du rje btsun ku sā lis// mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su khrid pa dang*// dpal ldan nā ro ta pa rjes bzung ltar// bdag kyang mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du 'khrid// rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gi thugs rje dang*// rgyud chen gsang mtha'i myur lam zab khyad dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog /ces kyang zhes tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad/ thal byung du smras so// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa de dag gis ni bdag cag rnams// rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sgra snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /ces smon lam btab/ de nas bkra shis ni/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang chen paṇa chen nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spros dang bsdu mdzad ma// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes brjid pa'i sku// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrog pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs// lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis// sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don// sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad ma// zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog
